title: Correcting what Chef Mealan read: one edit mode for the foods, by hand or by words
short: The foods of a read are corrected in one place: a pencil, rows to edit, and words for Chef Mealan
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: DT318: correcting what Chef Mealan read. One edit mode for the foods, by hand or by words

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:26, from a photo he logged; and 21:48 with a screenshot of a tester's read.
opportunity.job: Make the list of foods right after a read, quickly, so the meal I log is the meal I ate.
opportunity.kind: Several doors, each doing part of the job: a tap on a chip, Change the foods, a swipe, a link to a form, and Chef Mealan's own question. None says which to use.
opportunity.why_now: Every read ends here. B150 changes the same screen, so both are tested once.

problem: After the read I got a nice list of foods. Chef Mealan asked about the chicken and I chose 200 g. The yogurt was fixed at 10% fat, which I saw only in the food list, not on the chip. I tried to swap it, but there was no 0.2% yogurt. So I told Chef Mealan: it was 0.2% yogurt, and there was mayo. He read again and asked about the chicken a second time, now 220 g. The list was right in the end, but where and how to correct it was confusing.
story: When a read is not quite right, I want one place to correct the foods, with my hands or with my words, so that I do not hunt for the right door and nothing I set is lost.
words: 18 November 19:26: jogurt was with 10% fixed in the food list, not on the read chip. I tried to swap for 0.2% fat but such jogurt was not listed. I added info as mayo was not recognized and said that I had 0.2% fat jogurt. Then it asked me again about the chicken, this time if it was 220 g. A bit confusing where and how to update it.
cause: Replayed on the app as built in 0.3.159. The chip shows a short name, so 10% fat is cut off. The question about an amount is not on the read; it is on the screen behind Change the foods. The swap list offers foods from my own list. And a second read starts from the photo again: it drops the amount I chose and asks anew.
words2: 19:43: better an edit mode where what is needed is set, than another way of correction. 21:44: how would chips be edited? 21:48: saying it to Chef Mealan worked very well. If a chip can be edited, it should be deletable if wrong. Chef Mealan asks when not sure and suggests two options; both can be wrong. Or a food is doubled; that happened to a tester. So we have several places for making it better and each of them does some work. 21:51: yes to two doors, by hand and by words, in one edit mode.
proposed: One edit mode for the foods. The foods get a small title and one pencil. Closed, each chip shows the food's full name and its grams. A tap on the pencil opens edit mode in place, and the pencil turns into the X that closes it. In edit mode there are two ways. By words: on top, Tell Chef Mealan what is wrong, typed or said, then Read again. By hand: each food is a row with its full name, the grams as a field, Swap and Remove; under the rows, + Add a food. Every change by hand is saved at once. What I set or answered stays when he reads again, and he does not ask about it again. His own question stands on the read, under the chips, with a third answer, Neither, which opens edit mode on that food's grams.
more_change: Four things go that are built today. 1. Change the foods, the button on the read. 2. The tap on a chip that turns it into a number. 3. The link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it; its form is the top of edit mode. 4. Skip under his question; Neither takes its place. One link in edit mode still opens the screen behind Change the foods, for Retake, + Photo and Fit to my target.
open: Two things for your word. 1. The chips show the full name, Chicken breast, grilled 200 g. That is longer than today, and I said short names before. With short names the 10% stays hidden. 2. The link Retake, + Photo, Fit to my target keeps the second screen alive. Folding those three into the read would be a ticket of its own.
days: The board is drawn on the app's test photo. The foods are yours: chicken, sweet potato fries, yogurt, mayonnaise.
unchanged: The photo, the title, the meal line, This plate and What do you do with it?.
The swap list itself, and Find a food behind + Add a food.
Say it: the same voice input as on the photo form.
The Plate without a photo: its food list, the swipe, Fit to my target, Group into parts.
B150 draws the line under the title and the meal line; DT307 the bottom row. They are shown here as they will be.
details: No new screen. Edit mode opens in place, under the photo.
Read again sends the photos, my words, and what I set: foods I removed, amounts I typed or answered. The read keeps those.
One line from Chef Mealan says what the second read changed.
A food he added or changed is marked in the rows until edit mode is closed.
A tester's doubled foods are B152. Remove is the way out by hand until it is fixed.
The row DT318.1 on this board, steps 1 to 6 and Neither, is what it looks like.

ac.title: The foods have one pencil
ac.text: Given Chef Mealan read a photo, when I look under the photo, then the foods have the small title Foods and one pencil, each chip shows the food's full name and grams, there is no Change the foods, and a tap on a chip does nothing.

ac.title: The pencil opens edit mode in place
ac.text: Given that read, when I tap the pencil, then under the photo I see Tell Chef Mealan what is wrong, one row per food with its full name, grams, Swap and Remove, and + Add a food, the pencil is an X, and a tap on the X shows the chips again.

ac.title: Grams, saved at once
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I type 200 in the chicken's grams, then the plate's numbers follow at once, there is no Done, and closed the chip says 200 g without the ~.

ac.title: Remove
ac.text: Given edit mode with a food that is wrong or there twice, when I tap Remove on its row, then the row is gone and the plate's numbers follow.

ac.title: Swap
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I tap Swap on the yogurt's row and pick a food in the swap list, then that food stands in the row with the same grams.

ac.title: Add a food
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I tap + Add a food and pick one, then it is a new row at its normal portion, and I am still in edit mode.

ac.title: By words
ac.text: Given edit mode, when I write The yogurt was 0.2% fat. There was mayo too. and tap Read again, then the rows show Yogurt, 0.2% fat and Mayonnaise, and one line from Chef Mealan says what he changed.

ac.title: What I set stays
ac.text: Given I chose 200 g for the chicken, by his question or by hand, when Chef Mealan reads again, then the chicken is still 200 g and he does not ask about it again; and a food I removed does not come back.

ac.title: His question stands on the read
ac.text: Given the read is not sure about one amount, when the read opens, then the question is under the chips with ~200 g, ~350 g and Neither, and a tap on an amount sets it and closes the question.

ac.title: Neither
ac.text: Given that question, when I tap Neither, then edit mode opens with that food's grams ready to type, and the question is gone.

ac.title: The old doors are gone
ac.text: Given a read, when I look at the page, then there is no link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it and no Skip, and Retake, + Photo and Fit to my target are behind one link in edit mode.

ac.title: Three languages
ac.text: Given the app in English, Serbian or German, when I walk steps 1 to 6, then Foods, Tell Chef Mealan what is wrong, Read again, Swap, Remove, + Add a food, Neither and Chef Mealan's line are in that language.
